semiconductor_relevance: High — Micro-Mechanics specializes in high-precision parts and tools specifically designed for semiconductor assembly and testing processes.
summary: Micro-Mechanics (Su Zhou) designs, manufactures, and markets high-precision parts and tools used in process-critical applications for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include tools for die attach, pick-and-place operations, and adhesive dispensing, catering to the needs of semiconductor assembly and testing.
capabilities: Rubber and Plastic Pick-Up Tips for die attach and pick-and-place applications
Tungsten Carbide Tools for eutectic and MEMS applications
Adhesive Dispensing Nozzles with precision hole sizes
Die Ejector Needles in various materials

regional_presence.China: Micro-Mechanics has a manufacturing presence in Su Zhou, focusing on high-precision tools for the semiconductor industry.
